The author who expresses

The Other Side Of Nine

Discover the Hidden Truth Behind Every Perspective

By Sumanth Namburi · Clever Fox Publishing, 2026

Kindle eBookAmazon India(opens in a new tab) PaperbackAmazon US(opens in a new tab) Printed copy enquiryWhatsApp(opens in a new tab)

Scroll, and Perspecto finds the book.

Most of what we believe about a situation is only the part we can see from where we stand. This book is about the rest of it.

Through stories, practical insights and reflections from the Bhagavad Gita, Sumanth Namburi looks at how beliefs, assumptions and prior knowledge shape our decisions and relationships, and at what changes when we stop to ask what we have not yet seen.

It explores perspective, beliefs, assumptions, decisions, relationships and personal growth.

About

A life, in places

Business, education, art, community service and writing. Scroll, and Perspecto walks past the places in Sumanth’s story.

  1. 1Hindupur

    Where it begins

    Born and raised in Hindupur, Andhra Pradesh. Sumanth holds an MBA.

    As a boy he wondered why people disagree about the same moment.

  2. 2First steps in business

    Hyderabad, and the first role

    He began his career with Kansai Nerolac Paints in Hyderabad, where his first role was Territory Sales Supervisor.

    He learned most by observing people.

  3. 3Relationships and legacy

    A family in business

    His family’s gold and silver jewellery business is part of his background in business.

    Asset-Based Thinking: look first for what is valuable.

  4. 4Entrepreneurship and education

    Director, NSV EDUSPACE

    Through NSV EDUSPACE he has built his work around helping people learn practical skills and move towards careers. A Rotarian since 2018, he has also led in service.

  5. 5Mind, behaviour and meaning

    Why we see differently

    He is drawn to psychology, human behaviour, self-leadership, spirituality and personal transformation. His reading and reflection have drawn on the Bhagavad Gita and modern psychology, and on programmes including Inner Engineering, Ayyappa Deeksha and the Art of Living.

  6. 6Towards authorship

    From notes to a book

    He recorded ideas and stories from business, Rotary and daily life, writing around family and work. He doubted at first whether he could write in English; guidance from Inspiring Jatin, and his association with the International Council of Authors, gave him the confidence to continue. The book was launched at ICA Conclave 2026 in Goa.

Ideas he has named

Three frameworks, printed on the book’s cover.

OSP™

The Other Side Principle: seek what you have not yet seen.

NSVBT™

New System of Value-Based Thinking Through Perspective: uncovering the value inside our experiences.

PVQ™

The ability to make wiser decisions by seeing beyond the obvious.

His chapter My Journey, My Legacy: How Life Shaped Me into an Author appears in an International Council of Authors anthology. The approved text will be added here.

Education, skill development and career support

Sumanth Namburi, Director.

NSV EDUSPACE brings together education in accounting, finance, taxation, banking and computers with vocational training, and supports learners as they move into work through placement support, scholarships and industry connections.

  • Accounting & Finance

    Foundations for careers in accounts and finance.

  • Taxation

    Practical understanding of tax.

  • Banking

    Preparation for roles in banking.

  • Computer Education

    Digital and computer skills.

  • Vocational Learning

    Skills for specific trades and roles.

  • Career & Placement Support

    Placement support, scholarships and industry connections.

Areas of focus, not a list of current courses. For programmes and admissions, contact NSV EDUSPACE at nsveduspace@gmail.com. Current programmes and photographs are still to be added.
